sources.scope: Read bibliographic and search summary only. Used as state-abstraction/bisimulation prior-art lead, not for a detailed theorem attribution.

sources.title: Language Models Represent Space and Time
sources.scope: Read conference abstract. Used as empirical evidence that LLM internal representations can encode world-related spatial and temporal variables.

sources.title: I Predict Therefore I Am: Is Next Token Prediction Enough to Learn Human-Interpretable Concepts from Data?
sources.scope: Read conference abstract and indexed OpenReview/arXiv summary. Used as strong recent prior art for latent-concept identifiability from next-token prediction under explicit generative assumptions.

sources.title: Toward Consistent World Models with Multi-Token Prediction and Latent Semantic Enhancement
sources.scope: Read indexed abstract. Used as recent prior art that multi-token objectives can impose stronger belief-state structure; no detailed theorem imported.
